title: hylotelephium argutum subsp. carpaticum
intro: Hylotelephium argutum subsp. carpaticum, commonly known as the Carpathian stonecrop, is a subspecies of succulent plant in the sedum family. The Carpathian stonecrop is valued for its medicinal properties, which include lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure, as well as providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects that support overall health. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a cardioprotective agent, exerting anti-hypertensive and hypolipidemic effects, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Carpathian stonecrop include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
